summary: randompkga postinstall mutates installer's package.json to inject randompkgb dependency
details: randompkga@1.0.16 ships no library code (no index.js/main module). Its sole effect is a postinstall lifecycle script that changes directory into $INIT_CWD (the installer's project root) and runs `npm pkg set dependencies.randompkgb=^1.0.0`, silently writing a new runtime dependency into the installer's own package.json. On the next `npm install` (or in CI) the installer's project will resolve and execute randompkgb, a package the installer never chose to depend on. This is a dependency-tree hijack: installing randompkga hands the author a durable channel to run arbitrary code inside the installer's project via a sibling package they control, and it persistently modifies the installer's committed manifest.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
